reader_summary.overview: In this special episode Ben & David head to Recode’s SF office and sit down in the red chair with the one & only Kara Swisher! Kara tells the story of Recode. Kara is someone we’ve long looked up to at Acquired, and it was really special to have her join us on the show.

key_points.text: Kara tells the story of Recode.
We hope you enjoy the conversation as much as we did!
